summary: The corrected annual screening found no interior overlaps in 387–391 and one repeated overlap pair (Eastern Jin–Goguryeo) in each of 392 and 393. Boundary-only contacts are excluded; detected area intersections trigger review, not claims of shared direct control.
method: For each year, compare valid Cliopatria v0.2.1 GeoJSON longitude/latitude polygon rings. Detect strictly interior vertices sampled along every source edge and proper boundary-segment crossings; boundary-only contacts do not count as area overlap. This conservative screen triggers review only and does not establish a historical frontier, clip areas, or reassign territory.
runtimeDisposition: Only source outlines involved in a detected interior overlap are held in that year: Eastern Jin and Goguryeo in 392–393. Other outlines remain available under their existing source intervals and any separate review holds. Political-center and event points remain eligible to render. No polygon is clipped or transferred.

sourceNotes.use: Compared polygons are Cliopatria v0.2.1 source records (CC BY 4.0), labeled low-confidence interval models with unspecified control type. Geometric intersection alone does not prove direct control, disputed control, or a historical frontier. Preserve attribution and provenance; historical suitability and public display require separate review.

reviewLimitations: The preflight detects geometric interior overlap but does not determine historical control or the correct frontier.
Absence of a detected overlap does not validate a low-confidence interval model as an accurate annual historical boundary.
The source geometries remain unchanged and are not clipped, split, or reassigned.
This corrected screen supersedes earlier contact-sensitive counts for 387 and 394; boundary-only contacts are not treated as polygon-interior overlap.
